name: I Wanna Try
storyline:
A High difficulty platformer with a vast variety of worlds to complete and bosses to defeat. You play as Prisma, a Little Happy Shiny One that is capable of everything.

Explore, find secrets and try to get all the collectibles!

-The story takes place in a colorful world filled with familiar characters. One day, a special color alignment results in the birth of new living beings known as the Shiny Twins. Contradictory parties whose objectives are unknown-
summary:
A High Difficulty Platformer you need to Try!
Complete Levels, Defeat Bosses, Find Secrets and more!
Do you have what it takes to try?
